title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Ballroom, U. of California on 1970-06-21

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience tape that captures a high‑energy ’70 show, highlighted by standout Easy Wind, Not Fade Away and St. Stephen jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) tape with the expected slight haze of age but generally clear enough to enjoy the performance.  Fans rave about the vibrant set – especially the soaring Easy Wind, a punchy Not Fade Away into St. Stephen and a solid Good Lovin’ – while a few reviewers note cuts and occasional drop‑outs that temper the listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the musical performance and highlight several standout songs; recording quality is deemed good for its era despite some noted flaws, yielding an overall solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight haze and occasional cuts (Not Fade & Good Lovin) typical of a 1970 AUD tape; some listeners find it tolerable, others call it terrible, but overall the sound is considered decent for its age.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rock‑heavy ’70 set with a freewheeling, high‑energy vibe; no long acoustic or half‑hour jams but strong transitions, especially the NFA→St. Stephen sequence.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is noted for his relaxed, “reefer‑influenced” playing and hanging out with fans on the veranda, contributing to the show’s joyous vibe.
